items.q: What is this site?
items.a:
This is my project, the 'User-Friendly Atomic Shop'. It aims to provide transparent pricing, correct images
and user-friendly information about the Atomic Shop in Fallout 76.

items.q: How does it work?
items.a:
The site uses in-game data which gets compiled with the help of a member of the Fallout 76 community.
  Images and missing images are pulled from the game files and then reordered manually to match the order of the included items in the shop.
Prices are converted to other currencies based on SteamDB Atom pricing. Daily offers are compiled manually and stored to be automatically displayed.

items.q: How do I use this site?
items.a:
You can browse the Atomic Shop by clicking on the tabs at the top. Click on an item to see more details, including prices and images and share a direct link to them.
You can also use hotkeys to scroll through the tab bar and navigate images using A and D to move left and right.

items.q: Are prices official?
items.a:
Atom prices are pulled from in-game data and should be accurate to the time of the last update.
Conversion to other currencies is based on SteamDB Atom pricing and may vary by region and might not be correct or up to date.

items.q: What do the labels and badges on offers mean?
items.a:
Labels and badges provide additional information about the offers, such as whether they are new, on sale, or other special designations.
Hover with your cursor over the badges/labels to see more details about what they mean.

items.q: Why are there discrepancies between this site and the official in-game Atomic Shop?
items.a:
Some items do not show up ingame if you already own them, while this site shows all available items.
Additionally, some items only appear if you meet certain conditions or the site data might be outdated.
If you notice discrepancies, please feel free to report them via the feedback form or GitHub.

items.q: Why don't the daily free consumables always match today's item?
items.a:
The daily free consumables usually follow a weekly rotation, but Bethesda sometimes randomizes them (especially on Tuesdays).
Since I update the items manually based on what's shown in-game, they can occasionally be out of sync or in a different order.

items.q: Why does the website show a daily offer that isn't shown in-game?
items.a:
The daily offers on this site are based on Bethesda's official news blog, where upcoming items are listed in advance.
Occasionally those listings can be incorrect or are missing in-game when Bethesda makes changes (this often happens also on Tuesdays), which is why you might see an offer here that isn't available in-game.

items.q: Why are some images missing or incorrect?
items.a:
Some images may be missing or incorrect due to bethesda not providing better ones or errors on my side.
If you notice any missing or incorrect images, please feel free to submit better images via the GitHub repository.

items.q: How often is the site updated?
items.a:
The site's content is _usually updated on Tuesdays_ or and on Thursdays, but may take several hours depending on the extent of changes that have to be made.
 On patch days, updates might be delayed until the patch is live and the way to obtain the data is functional again.

items.q: Why is there an/no Weekly Offers Preview tab?
items.a:
The Weekly Offers tab provides a quick overview of the current week's daily offers for the upcoming days. The data is compiled from official sources when available.
If there is no Weekly Offers Preview tab, it means that the data for the upcoming week is not yet available.

items.q: Can I share single items or bundles?
items.a:
*Yes*, you can share items or bundles by clicking the share icon [share-icon]  in the item overlay upper left corner.
This will open a text box with a direct link to the item that you can copy and share.

items.q: Who is behind this project?
items.a:
This site is created and maintained by a Fallout 76 community member, with core data provided by another contributor and scripting assistance from _GitHub Copilot_.
If you have questions, feel free to use the _feedback form_ or contact me on social media. I use the same handle everywhere.

items.q: How can I support this project?
items.a:
You can support this project by sharing it with others, providing feedback, or contributing in any way you can.
At some point i might need help covering hosting and/or domain registration costs in the future.

items.q: Is there an GitHub repository for this project?
items.a:
*Yes*, the project is hosted on GitHub. There you can report issues, suggest improvements, or _submit better images_ for items.
A guide on how to contribute can be found in the repository. You can find the repository at the following link:

items.q: Can I buy items directly from this site?
items.a: *No*, this site isn't a store and is for informational purposes only. To purchase items, you need to visit the official in-game Atomic Shop in Fallout 76.

items.q: Is this site affiliated with Bethesda?
items.a: *No*, this site is unofficial and not affiliated with Bethesda.

items.q: Does this site collect personal data?
items.a: *No personal data is collected* by this site. We use *localStorage* only for storing user settings, like selected currency.

items.q: Do you run ads or track users?
items.a:
*No*, the site is fully ad-free and doesn’t use any tracking tools, analytics scripts, or third-party advertising services.
Everything here is provided purely for the Fallout 76 community, without any monetization or hidden advertising.

items.q: How can I report issues or suggest improvements or leave general feedback?
items.a: You can report issues or suggest improvements in _GitHub_ or leave general feedback via this site's _feedback form_.
